articles.title: KPMG faces big setback in Australia amid allegations of mishandling confidential data
articles.description: KPMG Australia has stopped bidding for new Victorian government contracts as an investigation into the alleged misuse of confidential client information deepens. The audit and consulting firm is also withdrawing from ongoing tenders, while facing possible job cuts, lower partner pay and wider restrictions on public sector work across Australia.

articles.title: ‘Indian student protests are making us proud': Activist Greta Thunberg hails CJP’s victory in London | Watch
articles.description: Activist Greta Thunberg joined Indian students' protest in London and expressed solidarity after Union Education Minister Dharmendra Pradhan tendered resignation. She hailed CJP’s victory and said Indian student protests are making us proud.
